meta.title: Warm cache
meta.description: During a human pause, repeats the last model request every pingEveryMin while the provider cache is alive, so the next turn does not pay to rewrite the prefix.

config.profile: Profile label in the log row; empty means the DSH profile name
config.minContextTokens: Skip pinging when the context is smaller than this many tokens
config.pingEveryMin: Ping interval, minutes (per model by default)
config.maxPauseMin: How long a pause keeps the cache, minutes (per model by default)
config.live: Really send the ping (false logs only)
